import hashlib
import json
import platform
import posixpath
import subprocess
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote

root, session = map(Path, sys.argv[1:3])
ns = {
    "a": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main",
    "p": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}


def target(relpart, name):
    base = "" if relpart == "_rels/.rels" else posixpath.dirname(posixpath.dirname(relpart))
    return unquote(name.lstrip("/") if name.startswith("/") else posixpath.normpath(base + "/" + name).lstrip("/"))


def read(name, selected=None):
    path = root / "Research/sources/author" / name
    data = {"path": str(path.relative_to(root)), "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "slides": []}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        assert z.testzip() is None
        data["zip_crc_ok"] = True
        data["core_properties_xml"] = z.read("docProps/core.xml").decode()
        names = set(z.namelist())
        data["part_sha256"] = {p: hashlib.sha256(z.read(p)).hexdigest() for p in sorted(names)}
        data["missing_internal_targets"] = []
        data["external_relationships_not_fetched"] = []
        data["xml_parsed"] = 0
        for part in sorted(names):
            if part.endswith((".xml", ".rels")):
                doc = ET.fromstring(z.read(part))
                data["xml_parsed"] += 1
                if part.endswith(".rels"):
                    for rel in doc:
                        if rel.get("TargetMode") == "External":
                            data["external_relationships_not_fetched"].append({"part": part, "target": rel.get("Target")})
                        elif target(part, rel.get("Target")) not in names:
                            data["missing_internal_targets"].append({"part": part, "target": rel.get("Target")})
        assert not data["missing_internal_targets"]
        rels = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in ET.fromstring(z.read("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"))}
        ids = ET.fromstring(z.read("ppt/presentation.xml")).findall("p:sldIdLst/p:sldId", ns)
        data["slide_count"] = len(ids)
        for number, sid in enumerate(ids, 1):
            if selected and number not in selected:
                continue
            part = posixpath.normpath("ppt/" + rels[sid.get("{" + ns["r"] + "}id")])
            doc = ET.fromstring(z.read(part))
            paragraphs = []
            for ordinal, paragraph in enumerate(doc.findall(".//a:p", ns), 1):
                runs = []
                for run in paragraph.findall("a:r", ns):
                    props = run.find("a:rPr", ns)
                    t = run.find("a:t", ns)
                    runs.append({"text": t.text or "" if t is not None else "",
                                 "properties": dict(props.attrib) if props is not None else {}})
                paragraphs.append({"ordinal": ordinal, "text": "".join(t.text or "" for t in paragraph.findall(".//a:t", ns)), "runs": runs})
            data["slides"].append({"number": number, "part": part, "table_count": len(doc.findall(".//a:tbl", ns)), "paragraphs": paragraphs})
        data["notes_and_comments_xml"] = {
            p: z.read(p).decode() for p in sorted(names)
            if p.endswith(".xml") and (p.startswith("ppt/notesSlides/") or p.startswith("ppt/comments/") or p == "ppt/commentAuthors.xml")
        }
        data["media_parts"] = [p for p in sorted(names) if p.startswith("ppt/media/")]
    return data


old = read("Введение. Понятия. Группы. Синтаксис.pptx", {3})
revision = read("Введение_1. Понятия. Группы. Синтаксис.pptx", {3})
new = read("Презентация1.pptx")
assert new["sha256"] == "4616a5e8950bede557b9bdb14ed9cfca8c7740c6c5d7b3ec930d0b7d552fc723"
record = {
    "timestamp": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), "host": platform.node(),
    "base_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    "command": [sys.executable, *sys.argv], "reproducer_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "readers": {"Python": platform.python_version(),
                **json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(session / "kpol159-reader-env/bin/python"), "-c", "import importlib.metadata,json;print(json.dumps({p:importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in ('markitdown','python-pptx')}))"], text=True)),
                "LibreOffice": subprocess.check_output(["libreoffice", "--version"], text=True).strip()},
    "new": new, "comparison_155_slide3": old, "comparison_157_slide3": revision,
    "comparison_limit": "New file is a one-slide thematic fragment, not a replacement of either full presentation. Old slide 3 is selected explicitly; no deletion inferred from absent topics.",
    "prior_slide3_text_equal": [p["text"] for p in old["slides"][0]["paragraphs"]] == [p["text"] for p in revision["slides"][0]["paragraphs"]],
    "markitdown_text": (session / "kpol159-markitdown.txt").read_text(),
    "render": {"file": str(session / "kpol159-render/slide-1.png"),
               "sha256": hashlib.sha256((session / "kpol159-render/slide-1.png").read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "dpi": 150},
}
out = root / "Research/studies/author-semantics/data/kpol-syntax-159"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with (out / "source-audit-01.json").open("x") as handle:
    json.dump(record, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    handle.write("\n")
print("new core:", new["core_properties_xml"])
print("notes/comments:", new["notes_and_comments_xml"])
print("xml/slides/tables/media:", new["xml_parsed"], new["slide_count"], [s["table_count"] for s in new["slides"]], new["media_parts"])
print("prior slide3 equal:", record["prior_slide3_text_equal"])
for paragraph in old["slides"][0]["paragraphs"]:
    if "Min" in paragraph["text"] or "Max" in paragraph["text"]:
        print("PRIOR:", paragraph["ordinal"], paragraph["text"])
for paragraph in new["slides"][0]["paragraphs"]:
    print("NEW:", paragraph["ordinal"], paragraph["text"])
